characters.continuity: DC Comics - Dark Nights: Death Metal / Flash Forward
characters.summary: Wally West imbued with the cosmic power of Doctor Manhattan possesses near-omnipotent reality-warping, temporal manipulation, and unimaginable energy projection, turning him into a cosmic entity far beyond a standard speedster.
weaknesses: Psychological burden and guilt from wielding excessive power
Connection dependent on Doctor Manhattan's residual energies
limitations: Power requires maintaining mental focus to avoid destabilizing reality
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard Speed Force channeling with Doctor Manhattan's blue energy, granting godlike reality-warping and temporal power instead of traditional super-speed physics.

sources.supports: General publication history and Doctor Manhattan-powered transformation context in Dark Nights: Death Metal

feats.claim: Repaired and restructured the fractured timeline and multiverse using Doctor Manhattan's powers.

notableResults.note: The Darkest Knight outmaneuvered and absorbed greater dark multiverse power before a decisive rematch.

campaignTags.claim: Ability to levitate and fly freely utilizing Doctor Manhattan's cosmic energy.

unknowns: The permanent upper limits of Doctor Manhattan's power when channeled through Wally West.

characters.id: dc:The Flash (Wally West)|Mobius Chair Wally West
characters.continuity: DC Comics - Flash Forward / Justice League
characters.summary: Wally West seated upon the Mobius Chair gains omniscience, infinite cosmic knowledge, and the ability to manipulate space and time across the universe.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychological manipulation by entities tied to the Mobius Chair's history
Physical separation from the chair strips away its cosmic benefits
limitations: Mobius Chair can impose overwhelming mental strain

sources.supports: Wally West sitting on the Mobius Chair and gaining universal knowledge.

feats.claim: Traversed dimensions and accessed the secrets of the multiverse instantly.

notableResults.note: Used the knowledge of the Mobius Chair to navigate complex dimensional crises.

campaignTags.claim: Instantaneous universal teleportation via the Mobius Chair.

unknowns: Full potential of combined Speed Force and Mobius Chair mechanics.

characters.summary: The Spectre is the wrath of God manifested as a near-omnipotent cosmic entity, dispensing divine judgment with reality-warping powers, invulnerability, and immense magical might, typically bound to a human host.
weaknesses: Requires a human host to properly channel and direct his full scope on Earth
Vulnerable to high-tier divine or anti-divine magic and the direct will of the Presence
limitations: Actions are limited by divine rules and the conscience of his mortal host

sources.supports: Spectre history, powers, and divine nature.

feats.claim: Reordered the stars and altered the fabric of physical reality during cosmic disputes.

notableResults.note: Defeated and banished Eclipso after a prolonged mystical conflict.

campaignTags.claim: Manifestation of divine magical wrath and cosmic forces.
Exerts reality-altering divine spells and curses.

unknowns: Exact parameters of what the Presence permits the Spectre to do without restriction.

characters.summary: Harvey Dent, former district attorney turned criminal mastermind, fights with dual firearms, tactical proficiency, and an obsession with probability determined by his scarred two-headed coin.
weaknesses: Obsessive-compulsive reliance on flipping his coin to make decisions
limitations: Human physical limitations and lack of superhuman traits

sources.supports: Two-Face's background, equipment, and criminal modus operandi.

feats.claim: Successfully took control of multiple Gotham crime syndicates using tactical planning.

notableResults.note: Defeated due to Batman exploiting his coin flip hesitation.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes stealth and criminal enterprise contacts for infiltration.

unknowns: Exact tactical response if separated from his lucky coin permanently.

characters.summary: Mari Jiwe McCabe harnesses the Tantu Totem to magically channel the abilities, strengths, and traits of any animal in existence, granting her incredible physical versatility.
weaknesses: Powers depend entirely on the presence of the Tantu Totem
Vulnerable to mystical items that sever animal connections
limitations: Must consciously select and manage animal traits to avoid sensory overload

sources.supports: Vixen's Tantu Totem abilities and animal mimicry powers.

feats.claim: Lifted heavy debris by channeling elephant and gorilla strength simultaneously.

notableResults.note: Matched Grodd's intellect and channeled superior beast strength to overcome him.

campaignTags.claim: Draws power directly from the mystical Tantu Totem.
Channels avian traits to achieve powered flight.
Channels aquatic animal traits for fast swimming.

unknowns: Limits to how many distinct creature traits can be channeled at once.

characters.summary: Princess Diana of Themyscira is an Amazon warrior possessing superhuman strength, speed, flight, and legendary combat skill, armed with the Lasso of Truth and indestructible bracelets.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to piercing weapons when caught off guard
Bound by strict Amazonian code of honor
limitations: Peak physical stamina is high but finite against peer cosmic entities

sources.supports: Wonder Woman's powers, weapons, and origin.

feats.claim: Stood toe-to-toe with Superman in physical combat and deflected Omega Beams with her bracelets.

notableResults.note: Defeated Bizarro using tactical combat skill and her magic lasso.

campaignTags.claim: God-forged weapons and divine Amazonian magic lineage.

unknowns: The full upper boundary of her power when divine constraints are completely removed.
